title: VFC HRMS & Sales CRM
summary: One product for Victory Financial Consulting (VFC), built as two apps in one codebase. The live app is hrms.vfcloans.com. HR and admin run the company. Sales employees run leads, calls, and loan cases.
features: HRMS for employees, attendance, leaves, salary slips, assets, tickets, and ID cards
Sales CRM for leads, masked calls, WhatsApp, follow-ups, and loan-case performance
Calling numbers verified with Airtel, Jio, and Truecaller so they are not marked as spam
Live updates for assignments, inbound messages, and who is on a call

sections.label: HRMS
items: Employee records, documents, and portal login control
Attendance from office biometric devices and a mobile face check
Leave requests and approvals
Salary slips

sections.label: Sales CRM
items: Lead upload and assignment to agents
Softphone calls on a masked company number
WhatsApp inbox on the company number
Follow-ups and a client pipeline

Call coach for dispositions
Live CRM presence and call recordings

sections.label: Call masking
items: The agent calls from the browser. The customer never sees the agent's personal number
The screen shows the company number from a pool of VFC caller IDs
Those numbers are verified with Airtel and Jio, and listed on Truecaller, so the call is not marked as spam
The pool rotates, with a daily limit on each number, so one line is not overused
Incoming and outgoing calls are saved on the lead, with the recording attached
If the softphone cannot connect, the call can fall back to a click-to-call voice line

title: VFC Loans
summary: The public website and staff panel for Victory Financial Consulting. Customers compare loans and apply on vfcloans.com. Staff run applications, leads, and documents from a separate admin panel. Both use one API.
features: Public site for home loans, loan against property, business, vehicle, and personal loans
Customer dashboard for applications, documents, and notifications
Staff admin for leads, applications, bank rules, and credit reports
AI assistant that answers from the company's rates, offices, documents, and products

sections.label: What it is
items: Victory Financial Consulting is a loan distributor. It does not lend its own money
The site compares offers from about 30 banks and NBFCs and carries the customer through documents and disbursal
Offices: Gurugram (Spaze I-Tech Park, Sector 49), Noida (Wave Silver Tower, Sector 18), and Mumbai (Gundecha Enclave, Sakinaka)

sections.label: Public site
items: Home loan, home loan balance transfer, and home loan top-up
Loan against property, LAP balance transfer, and LAP top-up
Business loan, MSME loan, vehicle loan, and personal loan
Home Saver, an overdraft-linked home loan
EMI, eligibility, and affordability calculators
CIBIL / credit check
Bank-approved housing projects
City pages for Gurgaon, Gurugram, Noida, Delhi, and Faridabad
Blog, careers, gallery, and contact

sections.label: Customer dashboard
items: Logged-in customers get a profile, their applications, document upload, and notifications
An application moves through draft, submitted, processing, approved, rejected, and disbursed
Staff comments stay on the application

sections.label: Admin panel
items: A separate React app for staff, with its own login
Dashboard, customers, applications, leads, interests, contacts, and offers
Gallery, bank rules, credit reports, notifications, visitor analytics, and user management

sections.label: AI assistant
items: The button on the site says AI Assistant
The customer types a question. The reply is written from the company's rates, offices, documents, and products
Groq writes that reply
Live bank-rate comparisons and “track my application” come from the database, not from the model

sections.label: Three apps
items: Website: React single-page app on Vercel, at www.vfcloans.com. React Router for pages, Redux Toolkit for shared state, Tailwind, Bootstrap, and Material UI for layout
Animation with Framer Motion and GSAP. Forms with Formik, React Hook Form, and Yup. Google login and reCAPTCHA on forms
Each production build writes a sitemap and a separate HTML file per public URL, so search engines get that page's title and description
Admin: a second React app, built with Vite, also on Vercel
API: Node.js and Express on Railway, with MongoDB. The website calls the API through vfcloans.com, so the browser stays on the public site
Files go to object storage. Email, SMS, and WhatsApp campaigns go out from the API. Live updates use Socket.IO

title: VFC Rise
summary: An MSME finance desk for VFC Rise Financial Services. It helps small businesses find a credit product, prepare documents, and send the file to a partner bank or NBFC. VFC Rise does not lend its own money. Sanction, rate, and disbursal stay with the lender.
features: Public site for MSME loans, schemes, eligibility, documents, and an EMI calculator
Customer desk to apply, upload documents, see offers, and track the file
Staff desk to verify a lead, route it to a lender, and track commission
Sister brand of Victory Financial Consulting. Home loans stay on vfcloans.com

sections.label: What it is
items: A DSA desk for micro, small, and medium businesses in India. The site says plainly: we do not lend money
Products include working capital, GST overdraft and cash credit, term loans, machinery, loan against property, CGTMSE-style cover, PMEGP, and trade finance
For manufacturing, trading, services, and retail, with desks in Gurgaon, Noida, and Mumbai
Copy does not promise a sanction, a rate, or a subsidy. Consent is in Hindi and English
Public site: www.vfcrise.com. Email: hello@vfcrise.com

sections.label: Public site
items: A product catalog of about 23 MSME loans, plus how it works, sectors, and Udyam bands
Eligibility notes, document checklists, and long guides
Blog on MSME knowledge, business loans, and government schemes
Bank comparison, an indicative EMI calculator, partner logos, and FAQs
Offices, about, fair practices, grievance, privacy, and terms
A guest quick apply, and a full apply once the customer is signed in

sections.label: Customer desk
items: Sign in with email, Google, or a one-time code
Profile, applications, offers, a document vault, messages, and history
A file moves from submitted, through document checks and lender review, to approved, rejected, or disbursed
The customer can accept or decline an offer, and a desk assistant answers questions on the account

sections.label: Staff desk
items: A separate admin app for the DSA team, with its own login
Lead queue, partner lenders, commission, and reports
Staff verify documents, route a file to a bank or NBFC, then record the bank status and the offer
Website content and the product list can be edited from the desk
Support tickets, team access, and an audit log

sections.label: Three apps
items: Website: Next.js on Vercel, at www.vfcrise.com. Tailwind for layout. Pages stay useful for search, with a blog, guides, and city-style product pages
Admin: a React app built with Vite, at admin.vfcrise.com
API: Node.js and Express on Railway, with MongoDB, at api.vfcrise.com
The website and the admin both talk to that one API. Published site text can come from the database, and falls back to the copy shipped with the site if the API is down
SMS and email are used for sign-in codes. There is no customer payment checkout. Commission is tracked inside the staff desk

title: Travel N World

APIs for packages, destinations, bookings, and enquiry management
AWS S3 and CDN for media storage and faster content delivery

title: Real-Time Chat

features: Live messages over Socket.IO and WebSockets
JWT login
Typing indicators, group chats, and online status
Redux Toolkit for client state
